messages:
jamie: Packaging check-in — finalizing airgap artifact + checksums for v1.4.3-private. Need signoff on cosign key rotation and image pinning before change window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Attaching build log.

alex: Built the installer on infra-qa; kms hook included at /etc/redwood/kms.d, passes unit tests and basic e2e.

sana: Quick Q — does the post-install KMS hook update the config path? Our infra expects /opt/kms/config, want to avoid surprises in customer VPC.

alex: It writes to /etc/redwood/kms.d and creates a symlink /opt/kms/config -> /etc/redwood/kms.d/config in the post-install step. Verified on vm: service comes up clean.

kevin: Security note: cosign key rotated on 2026-03-15. Recommend pinning the cosign signature ref for airgap installs so offline verifications don't break if key rotation happens again. +1 to pin.

release-bot: deploy-bot scheduled release: env=private-us-west1 window=2026-03-21T03:00Z-03:30Z, CI=passed, artifacts=airgap-1.4.3-20260320.tar.gz

jamie: Proposed rollback tag: rollback-1.4.2-stable. Plan: canary for 15m, if errors > 3% -> auto-rollback to tag. :thumbsup:

sana: Please add SHA512 to the notes for offline checksum verification. Tarball size is ~3.2GB so partners will want both sha256 and sha512.

alex: Checksums added to release artifact metadata:
```
sha256(airgap-1.4.3-20260320.tar.gz)= e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
sha512(airgap-1.4.3-20260320.tar.gz)= 1f40fc92da241694750979ee6cf582f2d5d7d28e18335de05abc54b7f6e6a5f97c0c8a3e7a8b3a7b3f2f9a1f0b8f3e8b9a8c7d6e5f4c3b2a190f0e1d2c3b4a5
cosignSigRef=cosign:v1:sha256:9876abcd1234ef5678...
```

kevin: I'll add an explicit installer verification step to docs: `cosign verify --key /etc/redwood/keys/pubkey.pem airgap-1.4.3-20260320.tar.gz`. Also adding a short troubleshooting section for offline ops.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall during the window and reachable via pager. Rollback command (tested): `/opt/redwood/bin/airgap-rollback --tag rollback-1.4.2-stable`. I can run it if canary crosses thresholds. :white_check_mark:

jamie: Thanks all — locking the release branch, opening the PR with release notes, and pushing RC artifacts to s3-private-bucket (private). Will ping partner-ops and customers after upload. @ops-oncall please ack once you're connected to the customer VPN before t-15m.
